contests.title: County Question - Parks
contests.scopeNote: Exact English question from the current official all-contests sample.

provenance.sourceOrg: Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections
provenance.quote:
PARKS, SPORTS, RECREATIONAL
FACILITIES AND BOTANICAL GARDENS TO
BE FINANCED BY GENERAL OBLIGATION
BONDS
Shall the County issue general obligation bonds
in an amount not to exceed $280,000,000,
bearing interest at rates not exceeding the legal
limit and maturing not exceeding 20 years from
the date(s) of issuance payable from ad
valorem taxes levied on all taxable property
within the County to modernize aging parks and
recreation facilities and botanical gardens,
expand and update sports complexes, increase
public beach access and trail connectivity and
develop new regional parks?

contests.title: County Question - Library District
contests.scopeNote: Exact English question from the current official all-contests sample. Library District applies only to that taxing district, not the whole county.

provenance.sourceOrg: Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections
provenance.quote:
LIBRARY DISTRICT EXPANSION AND
MODERNIZATION PROGRAM TO BE
FINANCED BY GENERAL OBLIGATION
BONDS
Shall Palm Beach County issue bonds in the
aggregate amount not exceeding
$175,000,000, bearing interest at rates not
exceeding the legal limit and maturing not
exceeding 20 years from the date(s) of
issuance, payable from ad valorem taxes levied
for such purposes within the Palm Beach
County Library District for the purpose of
providing funds to pay for the cost of
acquisition, construction, reconstruction,
expansion, improving and equipping Palm
Beach County library facilities?

contests.title: County Question - School District
contests.scopeNote: Exact English question from the current official all-contests sample.

provenance.sourceOrg: Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections
provenance.quote:
REFERENDUM TO CONTINUE AD VALOREM
LEVY FOR SCHOOL SAFETY, TEACHERS
AND OPERATIONAL NEEDS
Shall the School District of Palm Beach County
have continued authority to levy 1.00 mills of ad
valorem millage for operational needs of public
schools dedicated to funding school safety;
school police; mental health services; arts,
music, physical education, career and choice
program teachers; and improved teacher pay
beginning July 1, 2027 and automatically
ending June 30, 2031, with oversight of all
funds by an independent committee of citizens
and experts?

scopedCoverageNotes.text: Current official three-page all-contests sample covers every race and question printed for the county November3,2026 General Election. This local packet includes all10 contested local offices and21 printed candidate names, plus5 Fourth District Court of Appeal retention questions/judges using exact held IDs, and all3 printed local questions. Federal, statewide and legislative fields remain outside this local install.

All1634 pages of the separate official precinct-sample PDF were inspected by native text extraction. Every occurrence of each10 local contested field contains its full exact name set, with no mismatch. It contains812 regular precincts and five additional9901.*/9902 style identifiers; four backs are blank. Exact observed field/precinct/style/page relations are preserved for geography joins. The five special identifiers are not presumed geographic precincts.

The official county-embedded2026 candidate report has21 Qualified local rows, matching the21 printed candidates by office and field count. Sample ballot names govern display; differing formal filing names are kept in source comparison evidence. The57 other rows are recorded with their exact Elected/Defeated/Withdrawn/Did-not-qualify status and are not installed as November contestants. Elected status is not reclassified as a cancellation without a specific source.

No local Write-in option is printed in the all-contests sample; blank write-in options for federal/state races are excluded from this local packet. The embedded local candidate report contains no explicit write-in row. No named declared write-in identity is fabricated and no blanket statewide write-in absence is asserted.

County Commission and School Board districts, Port, Soil and Water Conservation, Indian Trail, Avenir and County Library taxing district retain their exact electorates. Port charter boundaries expressly cover only part of the county. Nominal district IDs and observed precinct facts are data-ready; source-backed boundary/division joins remain a River dependency. Existing Palm Beach County→Fourth Appellate District membership is preserved.

Original current all-contests PDF, county-embedded status HTML, official33-page voting-district PDF and official Port boundary HTML are included with hashes. The57.9MB precinct PDF remains saved in task evidence at /workspace/cx-local-work/palm-beach/raw/amendments.pdf with its original URL/hash; the filename was inherited and is not a constitutional-amendment booklet. Compact field/style observations, source acquisition metadata and reproducible audit script accompany this packet. Preparation makes no production writes.
